neutrino_facts_established: k*tau > max(20, lmax-4) triggers the lmaxnu_high_ktau downgrade
dlna_nu is a separate step-size limit, NOT shared with dlna_acoustic
nu_l_accuracy_boost = lAccuracyBoost (equations.f90:511), and the pinned reference uses l_accuracy_boost = 2.0, so lmaxnu_tau = int(4*2) = 8, not 4
accurate_massive_neutrinos defaults to .false. in CAMB, so high_ktau really does use lmaxnu_tau=4 there
lmax_nu_high_ktau 4 -> 8 changes the high-k mean from +0.8735% to +0.8647%: nothing
dlna_nu 1.0 vs 0.20 gives bit-identical ratios, so the ladder is not step-limited for k <= 5
camb_facts_established: halofit_version='mead2020' maps to imead=3 (halofit.f90:626), so As = 5.196
Mead FDAMP/ALPHA clamps are in halofit.f90:181-184
sig8z_cold is sigma8 of the neutrino-free spectrum and feeds eta, k_star, k_damp and fdamp simultaneously
delta_p_b = cs2*clxb is CAMB's own default (equations.f90:2466-2467, evolve_TM off)
GetScalarSource is not exposed through the Python transfer interface, so source-level comparison needs a Fortran instrument

cs2 (10x change moves dm in the 8th digit)

optimisations: precompute kk/kk2 over l once per rhs instead of 2.24M per-multipole calls
